prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. New visual direction for the Roblox game shop, based on supplied REFERENCE images. Image 1 is the actual game world and simple Roblox assets. Image 2 is the actual HUD typography, outline and panel reference. Image 3 is the correct blocky low-poly asset style, with very simple faceted shapes and flat color areas. Match these graphics closely. This is NOT an edit to those screenshots; generate a new proposed SHOP screen consistent with them.
USER CORRECTION: previous drafts were far too glossy, detailed and animated-film-like. This new shop must be low-poly, less detailed, MORE COLORFUL and full of GAME character. STRICT VISUAL RULES: plain flat saturated colored panels, 2-3 solid tones per object, hard polygon planes, chunky primitive block/cylinder geometry, flat-shaded actual Roblox viewport-like previews, clean cocoa outlines. No fur, no individual wood grain, no stitched fabric, no realistic metals, no realistic lighting, no realistic miniature dioramas, no glossy toy/Pixar rendering, no giant mascots, no shopkeeper, no slogans on background signs, no floating sparkles, no textured paper. Friendly simplified bold rounded game font like the supplied HUD. The UI must occupy about 92% of the image; world is only a narrow slightly dimmed border matching screenshot 1. Flat crisp 2D UI composited with LOW POLYGON 3D item thumbnails. High readability and obvious hierarchy. Restrained cream only for neutral text surfaces; use strong grassy green, sky blue, golden yellow, coral, teal and violet for large meaningful category areas. Thick simple silhouettes and little playful asymmetrical corner tabs give personality without clutter. No decorative background scene competing with content. Landscape 16:10 actual-screen mockup, no devices, no cinematic logo. All statistics are sample player state. Tiny label 'DRAFT • SAMPLE DATA'. SCREEN: category landing page. Compact full-width top bar labelled 'SHOP' on left; simple gold coin balance '2.8M', brown green-capped acorn balance '240', red square close X on right. Under header a compact search field 'Find something...'. SIX very large organized cards in 3 columns and 2 rows. Each card has a bold solid color top area with one or two LOW-POLY blocky objects, plus pale label strip below. Exact cards: 'Upgrades' yellow card with simple angular padlock and faceted sack; 'Home & Garden' green card with a simple 12-part house with flat green triangle roof and square blue windows; 'Companions' blue card with blocky faceted tan dog like reference 3 and simple yellow duck; 'Rides' coral card with a very simple teal scooter made of cylinders and cuboids; 'Supplies' violet card with low-poly red plunger and blocky gum cube; 'Style & Crates' teal card with plain wooden cube crate and simple pink pig model. Beneath each title only one short descriptor: 'Earn • Defend • Rob', 'Build your place', 'Guards • Pets', 'Get around', 'Ready for a robbery', 'Find your next piggy'. Pig models use a simple low-poly rounded box body, four stubby polygon feet, two triangular ears, black dot eyes and cylindrical snout, no smile or plush realism. Bottom simple slim buttons 'YOUR BAG' and 'ACHIEVEMENTS'. No sidebar on this landing screen, no character standing outside it. Look bright, playful, very organized, game-native and buildable with Roblox Frames and ViewportFrames. Objects should visibly have flat polygon planes.

Apply ONLY flat materials and very simple large color patches. Grid labels: Bubblegum pink, Mint Choc mint/brown, Sunset orange, Midnight navy; Lava orange/black, Galaxy violet, Pearl offwhite, Bronze flat bronze; Gold Leaf ochre, Ember Glow red, Diamond pale-blue angular, Supernova purple/orange. Edit the provided shop UI mockup precisely. Preserve the full composition, layout, all labels, bright flat category colours, low-poly style, crate, odds, ownership chips and price. Change ONLY the 12 animal preview meshes in the collection grid: they incorrectly look like pointy-eared DOGS. Replace every one with an unmistakable LOW-POLY PIGGY BANK: one very FAT horizontally stretched barrel body with flat polygon faces, no distinct squared dog head or neck, tiny wide-set triangle ears, protruding broad ROUND polygon-disc snout on the front of the body with TWO VERTICAL NOSTRILS, little black dot eyes, four VERY SHORT stubby legs and a dark coin slot centered on the back. Body volume 3 times taller than leg height. No long muzzle, no black dog nose. Use about 100 triangles per pig, simple flat matte plastic colours matching each original tile, no textures or realistic shading. Keep all piggies visible even NOT OWNED. Also remove the two green plus signs from the currency header, leaving only read-only balances. Do not change anything else. The result should be a bright game-native Roblox interface, not plush toys or detailed animated film characters.

Use the supplied image as the visual-style reference for a NEW MOBILE GAME SHOP concept sheet. Match its bright flat yellow/green/blue/coral/violet/teal colour areas, thick cocoa outlines, bold readable labels, and simple faceted low-poly Roblox items exactly. Create TWO landscape phone UI drafts stacked vertically in one portrait presentation image, on a plain light blue backdrop, without hardware bezels or perspective. Label panels 'MOBILE • CATEGORIES' and 'MOBILE • UPGRADE DETAILS'. Upper panel: compact SHOP title, coins 2.8M and acorns240 with NO plus or currency purchase buttons, large close X. Six simple colored category tiles 3 columns x2 rows, readable labels Upgrades, Home & Garden, Companions, Rides, Supplies, Style & Crates, each with one SMALL low-poly icon. Tiny footer Your Bag / Achievements. Remove large art to make room for real touch-sized text. Lower panel: back button and Bigger Sack title, balances, close X. Compact tabs Earn / Defend / Rob at top. Two-column detail layout: left a low-poly faceted brown sack thumbnail and LEVEL1 → LEVEL2; right a very readable simple NOW / NEXT comparison, Loot per grab 9.8% → 11.6%, green improvement +1.8 pts. Bottom fixed wide green action UPGRADE • 6,240. Text: Take more coins per grab. Give the lower panel no category sidebar, no dense four-card grid, no competing buy buttons. Generous safe margins, minimum 48pixel-equivalent touch targets. Flat matte objects, at most3 tones each, no fabric, no wood grain, no realistic light, no mascots, no marketing slogans, no floating particles. This is a clean easy mobile GAME UI, not a website. Small label DRAFT • SAMPLE DATA. Each phone canvas must have around2:1 landscape aspect ratio and big text.
